svg.title: Tile-resident: the planes stay in the core's L1
svg.text: Tile-resident: a tile's planes never leave the core that took it
Sponza's overview, 1,920 x 1,080, lit, one P150A; MB are a frame's, over all cores
stage-wise (lit): each step a command on all 120 cores; the planes go to DRAM and back between them
DRAM: the frame's planes, written whole by one command, read whole by the next
tile-resident (lit_threads): one core runs every step of the tile it took; the planes stay in its L1
one Tensix core, one tile thread
pack's ms a frame a core, the cores' median
